data.long_meaning: Vibhorraj is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'Vibh' meaning power and 'Raj' meaning rule. This name signifies the god of power and courage. It is believed that the bearer of this name will be blessed with strength, wisdom, and the ability to rule over others.

data.cultural_impact: The name Vibhorraj holds significant cultural impact in Hindu tradition. In Hinduism, power and courage are highly valued virtues. The name reflects a sense of strength and determination, which is greatly admired in Indian society. Vibhorraj is also associated with the god Vibhuto, a manifestation of Vishnu, the preserver god in Hinduism. This association further reinforces the name's cultural impact, as Vishnu is revered as the supreme god in Hinduism.

It signifies the divine power that resides within each individual, reminding us of our inner strength and ability to overcome challenges. The name also reminds us of the importance of courage and bravery in the spiritual journey of life. The counsel of this name can inspire us to face our fears and approach life with confidence and determination, knowing that we have the power within us to overcome any obstacle. Additionally, the name Vibhorraj can serve as a reminder of the Hindu philosophy of Tapas, which emphasizes the importance of inner strength, discipline, and focus in the spiritual journey. Ultimately, the name Vibhorraj encourages us to tap into our inner power, cultivate courage, and live fearlessly.

historical_references.reference: VibhORaj was a famous Hindu king of the Chandela Dynasty who ruled around 1093 CE in Central India. He is known for his military prowess and architectural achievements, particularly the construction of the Khajuraho temples.

Another reference to VibhOraja can be found in the 12th-century Sanskrit epic, the Mahabharata, where he is mentioned as a king of the Panchala kingdom. In the epic, Arjuna pays homage to Vibhoraja before the Battle of Kurukshetra.
